objective: Inspect source-assigned Subject and Index term labels on selected known records, map bounded candidates to protocol blocks, compare free-text and free-text-plus-descriptor unions, and review every descriptor-only record.

diagnostic_window.cutoff_handling: PQDT applies year precision. Records in 2026 require later screening against the exact diagnostic cutoff.

source_controls.database: exactly one allowed PQDT Global database label

record_selection.basis: Fourteen Pilot 004 records whose title or abstract explicitly joins a CubeSat or nanosatellite case to MBSE, SysML, digital engineering, or structured system-model work.
record_selection.purpose: Known items for this vocabulary test only.

assignment_plan.route: source-created Abstract/Details view from each canonical PQDT record
assignment_plan.acceptance: Both complete passes must return the same ordered field groups and labels for every selected document ID.

candidate_plan.mapping_rule: A candidate must be assigned to at least one selected record and must represent one declared protocol block without broadening its meaning.
candidate_plan.generic_systems_engineering_rule: A generic systems engineering label cannot satisfy M_H alone. It requires an assigned model or modeling label in the same field construction.

comparison_plan.candidate: each free-text block OR its validated exact descriptor block
comparison_plan.events: fresh strict baseline and augmented events for every affected partition
comparison_plan.acceptance: The augmented set must retain every baseline ID. Every descriptor-only record must be reviewed against the intended mapped concepts before adoption.
